# Destroy Effect

Source: [wiki article 8473](../archive/8473.md); edited 2026-03-17.

Exact pinned API: [Destroy Effect](../../api/actions/destroy-effect.md).

<a id="wiki-8473-n1"></a>

- Destroy Effect accepts an array of entity IDs and destroys all effect entities in it; the note supplies share code NV3FE6 as a verification example.

<a id="wiki-8473-n2"></a>

- Store Last Created Entity in a variable for later targeted cleanup.
